title: Signal Modeling Seed Source
description: The seed data source for a modeled signal: its training data type and whether the provider signed it.

provider_signed.description: Whether the seed source carries a signed attestation under one of the provider's published signing keys. This is a forward-looking claim until the consumer can resolve and verify the provider's applicable signing keys through the AdCP signing profile; consumers MUST NOT treat this boolean alone as cryptographic proof.
